I support the order. I would change two things so the checks catch violations instead of passing bad state.

- **288 cut line:** The replacement text for line 36 must be testable red first. A rank check should fail when a non-blocking process card sits above the cut line, and it should fail when a card that names an open audit FAIL is not first. Otherwise the cut line is a rule with no detector.
- **278 and 270:** Put the empty-vote guard in the test before the fix lands. An empty attempt must fail instead of counting as a vote, and every counted vote must still carry a valid cite. Otherwise 229 and 270 could pass while still hiding the stderr.

I agree with 277 coming after the fix, so its trips are tested on real causes. I also agree with deferring the drift criterion until its measure is pre-registered.
